name: Architecture Principles & ADRs
description: Architecture Principles & ADRs standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-ARCH applies.

rules.title: Document significant architecture decisions with ADRs
rules.detail: Record context, decision, alternatives considered, consequences, owner and date for decisions that materially affect structure, dependencies, data, security, scalability or operability.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Document significant architecture decisions with ADRs.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Document significant architecture decisions with ADRs.

rules.title: Define system boundaries and dependency direction
rules.detail: Make module/service boundaries explicit and keep dependency direction consistent with the chosen architecture; domain/business rules must not depend on delivery or infrastructure details.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define system boundaries and dependency direction.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define system boundaries and dependency direction.

rules.title: Prefer explicit contracts between boundaries
rules.detail: Define APIs, events, data contracts and extension points at boundaries so components can evolve independently and be tested in isolation.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Prefer explicit contracts between boundaries.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Prefer explicit contracts between boundaries.

rules.title: Design for replaceability at volatile boundaries
rules.detail: Abstract external services, persistence providers and framework-specific concerns when replacement or testing cost justifies the indirection.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Design for replaceability at volatile boundaries.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Design for replaceability at volatile boundaries.

rules.title: Evaluate cross-cutting quality attributes before implementation
rules.detail: Capture expected security, availability, performance, maintainability and deployment constraints and show how the architecture addresses them.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Evaluate cross-cutting quality attributes before implementation.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Evaluate cross-cutting quality attributes before implementation.

rules.title: Review architecture drift for material changes
rules.detail: Changes that bypass defined boundaries or introduce new patterns require an ADR update or an explicit approved exception.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Review architecture drift for material changes.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Review architecture drift for material changes.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-ARCH applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Architecture Principles & ADRs to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Architecture Principles & ADRs is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Architecture Principles & ADRs failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
